Free Online Card Shedding Game

7 Cards Least Daily Challenge

Solve today's deterministic lowest-score puzzle with 3 strategic card-shedding turns.

Welcome to the official 7 Cards Least Daily Challenge! Every calendar day, a brand new puzzle is generated using a deterministic date seed. Every player globally receives the exact same starting 7 cards, the exact same zero-point Table Joker rank, and the exact same top discard card.

🎯 How the Daily Challenge Works

  • 3 Strategic Turns: You have 3 discard and pickup decisions to reduce your hand's point liability as much as possible.
  • Zero-Point Jokers: Any card in your hand matching the day's Table Joker rank counts as 0 points.
  • Match & Skip: If your discarded card matches the rank of the top card on the discard pile, you trigger Match & Skip—bypassing the pickup step and permanently shrinking your hand.
  • Reproducible & Fair: Your final score is saved in your browser and verified against the daily seed. Share your score summary with friends to see who sheds best!
